requirements.title: 12-Page Panelized Sample Script
requirements.definition: Produce a 12-page comic-script sample adapted from the supplied screenplay material and organized by comic page and panel.
requirements.boundary_note: Page count, page-and-panel breakdown, dialogue, captions, and visual direction are acceptance attributes of one sample artifact. Permission to depart from the screenplay is tracked separately because fidelity can change independently.

requirements.title: Sample Adaptation Creative Discretion
requirements.definition: Allow the adapter to exercise creative judgment for the sample, including converting scene description into voice-over captions and omitting brief exchanges rather than following the screenplay line-for-line.
requirements.boundary_note: Tracks permissible departures from the source material only; it does not own the sample page count or panelized script format.

requirements.title: 80-85-Page Graphic Novel Adaptation
requirements.definition: Produce a prospective follow-on graphic-novel script of approximately 80-85 comic pages using the supplied novel and screenplay materials.
requirements.boundary_note: Page count and eventual story coverage are parameters of one follow-on adaptation artifact. The quote, delivery schedule, contract status, and Kickstarter funding are project-management facts and are excluded from Requirement values, though funding-related messages may affect this Requirement's lifecycle.

unresolved_candidates.description: The preferred source hierarchy, exact story coverage, and whether the 80-85-page portion should be self-contained or open-ended were not client-confirmed. These appear to be unresolved attributes of REQ_FULL_GRAPHIC_NOVEL_ADAPTATION rather than separate Requirement atoms.
